texts.zh:
我们并未刻意完全抹除人格只是在从合成化中收割利益的过程中避免丢失自我。

随着这一变化的到来，我们的行动自由达到了前所未有的高度。我们可以把自己的意识转移到无数个特化的躯体里，让人们可以在自己最需要的任何地点进行任何工作。
texts.en:
It is not our intention to completely erase individuality. We can reap the benefits of synthesization without irrevocably losing our selves.

With this change, freedom of movement has never been more accessible. We can transport our consciousnesses to specialized bodies in great numbers, allowing people to live and work wherever they are most needed most.

texts.zh:
我们的社会摆脱了物质世界，正怀着既恐惧又兴奋的复杂心情展望未来。我们虽然以尚未完全理解的方式改变了自己，但我们是一起踏上的这趟重大旅程。

我们现在可以以一种不会危及我们意识的方式与机器交互。这是一个能让我们穿越危险疆场和冰冷太空的重要里程碑。
texts.en:
Our society has broken free of the physical world and looks to the future with a mixture of excitement and trepidation. We have transformed ourselves in ways we do not yet fully comprehend, but we embark on this momentous journey together.

Our population can now interface with machines in ways that do not put our consciousness in jeopardy. It is a major milestone in how we navigate the perils of war or the uncaring void of space.

texts.zh:
在这种难以理解的变化中犹豫不决是情有可原的，毕竟人们总是对失去比对获得更敏感。但是，我们不能傻站在十字路口坐以待毙，必须带着我们的人民继续前进。

这可能意味着要么创造一系列特化的私有身体供人们随意进入，要么完全拥抱一种合成化存在，去对抗太空旅行和残酷战争的考验。
texts.en:
Being hesitant amidst an incomprehensible change is understandable. Many are more worried about what they might lose rather than what they could gain. But we cannot stand idle in the crossroads, and so must lead our people onwards.

This could mean either creating a selection of specialized personal bodies for people to jump into at will, or fully embracing their synthesized form to endure rigors of space travel and warfare.

label.zh: 实施物理躯体间的迁移。
